name: Lancet
author: E. T. Carter
description: A three-quarter view up a blue-black cathedral nave: an arcade of compound piers and pointed arches recedes on the right with coral leaded lancets glowing in the aisle beyond, while sun through the clerestory slants a broad tinted shaft through dust and lays a row of stained-glass window images across the far wall. The view glides slowly down the nave as the haze churns and motes drift.

params.label: Light shafts
params.effect: How strongly the haze lights up where sun passes through the lancets.

params.label: Sun height
params.effect: Raises the sun: low values throw long raking shafts across to the far wall, high values drop them steeply onto the floor.

params.label: Dust motes
params.effect: How many dust motes drift through the shafts.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Speed of the slow glide along the aisle.
